subject: Request: Accelerator trial top-up & extension — Urban Labs
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@urbanlabs.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Accelerator trial top-up & extension for Urban Labs' demo run

Hi Aditya,

Hope you're well — quick ask from our side. We're running a 6-week demo cohort with five early customers next month and we just realized our current Redwood sandbox allocation will run out mid-run. The accelerator team at Urban Labs was hoping to request a) a 60–90 day extension on the trial window, and b) a temporary top-up of credits to cover higher-than-expected inference during live demos (roughly an additional 150k tokens).

We'd be happy to sign a short MOU or amend the existing trial agreement — the demo is timeboxed and the usage spike is transient. Attaching a short program outline so you can see the milestone plan.

Participants on our side: Govind Patel (seed investor & coordinator) and I. Can you advise next steps and who at Redwood needs to sign off? We're working on tight timing and would appreciate an expedited review.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Growth Lead, Urban Labs
Attachments: program-outline.pdf
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
To: Samira Khan <samira@urbanlabs.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Accelerator trial top-up & extension for Urban Labs' demo run

Samira — thanks for the context and the outline. I can fast-track this but I need two things for internal approval: 1) short milestone list that ties the extra tokens to measurable outcomes (demo dates, customer count, expected token burn per demo); 2) confirmation you'll sign the short amendment (we typically require an MOU for extensions >45 days).

Looping in Neha (program ops) and Grace (growth lead) to run an eligibility check. Neha — can you advise whether a 150k token top-up + a 60–90 day extension is within our standard accelerator concession window? Grace — FYI for deal economics.

Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Accelerator trial top-up & extension for Urban Labs' demo run

Aditya / Grace — quick internal note after a policy check. Accelerator/top-up playbook allows: up to 200k token one-time top-up and up to a 60-day extension under "pilot support" for qualifying programs (must be timeboxed, require an amendment, and be tied to explicit milestones). 90-day extensions are escalations for leadership approval and are rare.

For Urban Labs specifically I need the following to move forward:
- Milestone list (exact demo dates + expected attendees)
- Confirmation they'll sign the MOU amendment (one-page is fine)
- Short note on whether the usage will include any PII/regulated test data (affects audit scope)

If Aditya can get those today, I can approve up to 150k tokens + 60 days. Anything beyond that I will need Grace's explicit ok.

Neha Kapoor
Program Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>, Samira Khan <samira@urbanlabs.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Accelerator trial top-up & extension for Urban Labs' demo run

Samira / team — thanks for the prompt follow-up and the program outline. After reviewing the milestones and taking a quick look at Urban Labs' public briefing, we can approve a conditional top-up. Approved terms (conditional):
- 150,000 token credit top-up to the current sandbox allocation
- 60-day trial extension from the current expiration date
- Urban Labs to sign a one-page amendment (credits-amendment.pdf attached) and agree to the milestone report at the end of the demo period
- No regulated customer data to be processed during the sandbox demo; if that changes, pause and inform Neha immediately

I'll also require the Deal ID noted in HubSpot (DL-2025-09317-UL) and a signed amendment before we un-pause provisioning. Jordan — please prepare a DocuSign envelope with the attached amendment and set a 5-day signing TTL.

Grace O'Connor
Head of Growth | Redwood Inference
Attachments: credits-amendment.pdf
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
To: Samira Khan <samira@urbanlabs.io>, Govind Patel <govind@seedstage.vc>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Accelerator trial top-up & extension for Urban Labs' demo run

Samira — great to confirm. Per Grace and Neha's guidance we've provisioned the conditional approval. Next steps:
1) I attached the one-page amendment (credits-amendment.pdf) — Jordan will send the DocuSign link (https://www.docusign.com/UL-amenment-09317). Please review and sign within 5 days.
2) Once signed we'll provision the 150,000 token credit and extend your sandbox expiration by 60 days. You'll get an email from our billing portal when credits are live.
3) Please reply here with the demo dates & expected attendees (simple bullets are fine) and confirm no regulated data will be used.

Thanks for moving quickly — happy to help if you want the amendment edited for your legal constraints.

Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

aditya@redwood.inference
